related.title: Johan Sverdrup 海上油田
related.why: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.whyEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.transferEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界；Johan Sverdrup 海上油田改以岸電、平臺整合與海底接回為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries; Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield centers on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照油氣與CO2物料與油藏物料與壓力，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Johan Sverdrup 海上油田，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以封存monitoring與不確定度為起點，設計一項能區分「分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界」與「岸電、平臺整合與海底接回」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare hydrocarbon/co2 balance with reservoir material/pressure and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from storage monitoring/uncertainty and propose an observation distinguishing separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries from shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks, including uncertainty.

history.title: Sleipner 油氣與碳封存
history.text: Sleipner 油氣與碳封存的公開資料展示分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage illustrate separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
